description: This file implements the QuicCryptoClientHandshaker class, which manages the QUIC handshake process including sending client hello messages, processing server responses, proof verification, and handling handshake states.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientHandshaker
classes.description: Manages the QUIC client handshake process, including message exchange, proof verification, and state transitions.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientHandshaker::ProofVerifierCallbackImpl
classes.description: Callback implementation for asynchronous proof verification.

methods.name: OnHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming handshake messages and directs processing based on message type.

methods.name: CryptoConnect
methods.description: Initiates the cryptographic handshake process.

methods.name: num_sent_client_hellos
methods.description: Returns the number of client hello messages sent.

methods.name: IsResumption
methods.description: Indicates whether the handshake is a session resumption.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Checks if early data was accepted.

methods.name: EarlyDataReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for early data acceptance or rejection.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Indicates if an inchoate reject has been received.

methods.name: num_scup_messages_received
methods.description: Returns the number of server config update messages received.

methods.name: chlo_hash
methods.description: Returns the hash of the client hello message.

methods.name: encryption_established
methods.description: Indicates if encryption has been established.

methods.name: IsCryptoFrameExpectedForEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Checks if a crypto frame is expected for a given encryption level.

methods.name: GetEncryptionLevelToSendCryptoDataOfSpace
methods.description: Determines the encryption level for sending crypto data in a given packet space.

methods.name: one_rtt_keys_available
methods.description: Indicates if 1-RTT keys are available.

methods.name: crypto_negotiated_params
methods.description: Returns the negotiated cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: crypto_message_parser
methods.description: Returns the crypto message parser.

methods.name: GetHandshakeState
methods.description: Returns the current handshake state.

methods.name: OnHandshakeDoneReceived
methods.description: Handler for handshake completion notification.

methods.name: OnNewTokenReceived
methods.description: Handles receipt of a new token.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Returns buffer size limit for a given encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Creates a decrypter for current 1-RTT keys (not implemented).

methods.name: CreateCurrentOneRttEncrypter
methods.description: Creates an encrypter for current 1-RTT keys (not implemented).

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure event.

methods.name: HandleServerConfigUpdateMessage
methods.description: Processes server config update messages.

methods.name: DoHandshakeLoop
methods.description: Main loop managing handshake state transitions.

methods.name: DoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes handshake state, possibly verifying cached server config.

methods.name: DoSendCHLO
methods.description: Sends a client hello message.

methods.name: DoReceiveREJ
methods.description: Processes server rejection messages.

methods.name: DoVerifyProof
methods.description: Performs asynchronous proof verification.

methods.name: DoVerifyProofComplete
methods.description: Completes proof verification and updates handshake state.

methods.name: DoReceiveSHLO
methods.description: Processes server hello messages.

methods.name: DoInitializeServerConfigUpdate
methods.description: Handles server config update initialization.

methods.name: SetCachedProofValid
methods.description: Marks cached proof as valid and notifies proof handler.
